single_account.disclosure: Same GitHub account may initiate and manually approve the diagnostic; this is not independent review or editorial approval.

workflow.expected_sha_rule: Exact full SHA of human-reviewed installed commit; unset until separate execution authorization; never bind to latest/main automatically

oidc.workflow_sha_and_commit: Bind exact human-reviewed execution SHA before execution; no wildcard

future_requirements: Separate ingestion environment policy; no diagnostic self-review inheritance

limitations: GitHub environment reviewers apply to every referencing job, not to HTTP methods or an individual workflow. GET-only scope is enforced by the frozen diagnostic code, distinct audience and exact Vercel workflow/SHA claims, not by an environment method ACL.

Do not use this policy for an ingestion-capable workflow. Never reuse this diagnostic environment for ingestion. Before any ingestion, stop and explicitly replace/revoke the diagnostic-only approval arrangement and review publication rules.
Do not infer editorial approval from environment name, reviewer approval, GET405, JWT validation or this policy.
Do not weaken an existing remote environment automatically. If enem-oidc-readonly exists with stronger/different protection, stop and request review of that actual state.
